articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%

articles.title: Bitcoin slips before U.S. inflation report as traders price in Fed rate increase
articles.snippet: Fed Governor Waller backs December tightening even if inflation cools, while falling oil prices offer some relief and Anthropic withdraws IPO pricing details.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin falls to nearly three-month low after disappointing inflation data

articles.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.snippet: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.
